Package com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.yaml

Class YamlHumanoidEntity

java.lang.Object
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.entity.Entity
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.entity.DumbEntity
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.entity.HumanoidEntity
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.yaml.YamlHumanoidEntity
All Implemented Interfaces:
BehaviorTriggers, WebSocket.Listener, org.bukkit.event.Listener
public class YamlHumanoidEntity extends HumanoidEntity implements BehaviorTriggers
A concrete HumanoidEntity that is configured entirely at runtime from an EntityDefinition parsed from a YAML file.

This class handles:

  • Name with optional hex colour
  • AI selection (Hostile, Neutral, Passive, Ranged, Default / custom)
  • Skin data application
  • Drop table construction (plain, amounted, selective, amounted-selective)
  • Attribute overrides (SCALE, MAX_HEALTH, …) applied on every spawn
  • Behavior triggers (Death, DealDamage, TakeDamage)
